title: 第6章  修习天地万法如掌上观纹
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
“合成。”
陆渊心中默念。
【本次合成词条为灵思[白]】
【正在合成】
【灵思[白]×243→聪颖[绿]×81→明心见性[蓝]×27→顿悟[紫]×9→入道[金]×3→悟性逆天[红]】
【注：同一路径下只可绑定一个词条】
陆渊双眼顿时一亮。
既然同一路径下只能绑定一个词条，那么剩余词条就先不管了。
【悟性逆天：修习天地万法如掌上观纹】
短短一句介绍，就道出了这个词条的强大之处。
绑定词条。
这一刻，他眼中的世界碎了。
锁妖井，狐妖，洞穴，黑暗，甚至是他，全部化作亿万碎片。
紧接着，碎片重组，世界亮了。
仿佛无尽天光刺破万古长夜。
他看见了自己。
就像是站在云端俯瞰一座城池，他正站在一个无法言说的角度。
皮肤，肌肉，血管，骨骼，一层层褪去，取而代之的是无数条散发着微光的脉络。
有的盘旋而上直抵天灵，有的曲折而下漫过足底。
彼此交错却不纠缠，井然有序，灿若星河。

灵力的运转，功法的路线，甚至是天地之力残留的痕迹。
以往那些不可见之物，此刻无比清晰地呈现在他意识之中。
随着考核结束，锁妖井下的几名考官已经不知道该说什么了。
“两百八十七！那小子居然杀了两百八十七只狐妖！”
“凡境二层，跳过选拔直升镇魔司，本以为他是个凑数的，谁能想到居然拥有如此恐怖的战力！”
“好小子，不愧是忠烈之后，即便是往年那些甲等也没有这么匪夷所思的。”
“不一样！往年的甲等是被考核评定为甲等，陆渊的甲等是因为考核最高只有甲等。”
“妖孽啊！我青州镇魔司什么样的天才没有，可在这小子面前谁还敢自称天才？”
“一般的天才从入门到镇魔校尉少说也要一年，他只用了一天！”
“等他领了蜕凡丹踏入初境，再修炼一套镇魔司功法，我都不敢想象这小子得强成什么样子。”
“什么这小子？明明是镇魔校尉陆大人！”
“哈哈哈哈哈......”
锁妖井外。
石碑上光芒亮起。
甲等战力的只有陆渊一人，乙等战力有七人，丙等和末等他就没有留意了。
原本林辰还因为拿到了乙等而沾沾自喜，可现在看到石碑上的排名，他心中是羞愧难当。
今日之耻，只怕来日也是无能为力了。
如果说第一次败在陆渊手中是被偷袭，那今天就彻底无话可说。
随手一拳就令他筋断骨折身受重伤，这得是多么可怕的修为。
若是在生死之战，只怕他现在已经凉了。

前所未有的苍白无力从心底涌出。
天堑般的差距，让他再也不敢对陆渊生出报复的心思。
一片惊叹声中，陆渊从锁妖井走出，穿过人群，步入钟楼。
从头到尾没有投来一丝目光。
林辰暗自松了一口气，随即心中又涌出强烈的羞愤。
被他视作劲敌的人却将他当做空气，甚至直接无视。
这比将他打成重伤还令他难以接受。
一口鲜血吐出，他双眼一翻，直接昏死过去。
陆渊并没有在意角落里的小角色。
他在考官的赞扬声中领取了一枚蜕凡丹。
丹丸呈棕色，看上去像一颗巧克力，表面有丹纹环绕，散发出阵阵药香。
通过这两天与老周的接触，他对这枚丹药并不陌生。
蜕凡丹，顾名思义，能够帮助武者蜕去凡俗之躯踏入初境，正式走上修炼之路。
第一境便是初境。
引灵入体，让灵力进入经脉，打通奇经八脉与十二正经，在体内形成周天循环，生生不息。
第二境是玄境。
引导灵力汇聚下丹田，开辟玄墟，并将其中的灵力不断压缩凝实。
第三境是化境。
玄墟逆向而上与神魂共鸣，冲开天地之桥，蕴化灵识。
等到灵识沟通天地，牵引天地之力铸造大道根基，就能突破化境踏入虚境，不过这些都是后话。

原本陆渊担心自己受限于资质，修炼进度将会比同境界修者缓慢数倍。
可现在有了【悟性逆天】的词条效果，之前的那点担心彻底烟消云散。
修炼天地万法如掌上观纹，这就意味着没有任何瓶颈与桎梏，只要功法与资源到位，境界跟着水涨船高。
收下蜕凡丹，对着发放奖励的考官拱手道了声谢，转身往楼下走去。
“陆大人！”
刚下楼梯，迎面走来一个身穿墨黑锦袍的中年人。
来人脸上堆着笑，热情却又不失恭敬。
“恭喜陆大人，锁妖井下斩妖二百七十八只，得甲等评定，入门便是镇魔校尉，当真是年少有为啊！”
陆渊脚下一顿，上下打量对方一眼。
三十出头，身穿墨黑暗纹锦袍，腰间挂着制式横刀，刀鞘蹭得锃亮。
“我认识你吗？”
中年男人一拱手，“在下苏定安，比大人早入门七年，在司内领镇魔卫之职。”
陆渊点头，“有事？”
苏定安凑上来一笑，“卑职若没猜错，大人这是要去精武阁？”
“不错。”
陆渊点头，也不意外。
通过入门考核的新人，领了奖励之后自然是要去精武阁挑选功法，有心人稍加思索就能猜到。
“这不巧了吗？卑职正好顺路，一起走一起走。”
说着，他顺势与陆渊并肩而行，从怀中摸出一本簿册递到陆渊眼前。
“陆大人初来乍到，或许需要这个。”

陆渊低头一看，簿册封面上用毛笔写着几个工整的大字——《青州镇魔司生存指南》。
旁边还有一行小字：苏定安著
“生存指南？”陆渊下意识问道。
“不错。”苏定安笑着一拍胸脯，“这本指南，可是卑职这七年来呕心沥血之作。”
“细说这青州镇魔司，门道可多了去了，哪个饭堂的饭菜可口，哪个茅房的坑位干净，哪个执事脾气好容易说话，哪些地方去得去不得，全在这本册子里。”
说着，他随便翻了一页。
“呐，胥吏名录。”
“书吏老周讨厌别人拍马屁，见了他少说话多点头；书吏老李有洁癖，找他办事前要先净衣冠；书吏老赵的媳妇儿跟城里的花匠跑了，这几天尽量别找他。”
又翻一页。
“看，精武阁导览。”
“一层是大众货色，二层是进阶功法，三层才是核心功法。”
“每层都有分区，东区是功法，西区是武学，西区武学又细分为拳脚类，身法类，兵刃类......”
陆渊点了点头，好像还真有点儿用。
有人的地方就有人情世故。
锁妖井考核获甲等评定，入门即是镇魔校尉，此刻遇到同僚示好也在情理之中。
他接过簿册，朝苏定安拱了拱手。
“多谢苏老哥！”
正要离开，耳边突然传来一声急叫。
“陆大人！”
就见苏定安笑眯眯看着他，食指和大拇指搓出了一个手势。

“诚惠，二两银子。”
content_en:
"Synthesis."
Lu Yuan thought silently in his heart.
[This synthesized entry is Lingsi [White]]
【Synthesizing】
[Lingsi [White] × 243 → Cleverness [ Green ] × 81 → Clear Mind and Nature [ Blue ] × 27 → Enlightenment [ Purple ] × 9 → Entering the Tao [ Gold ] × 3 → Understanding and Defying Heaven [ Red ] ]
[Note: Only one entry can be bound to the same path]
Lu Yuan's eyes suddenly lit up.
Since only one entry can be bound to the same path, the remaining entries will be ignored.
[Understanding is contrary to heaven: practicing all the laws of heaven and earth is like observing lines on the palm of your hand]
A short introduction shows the power of this entry.
Bind terms.
At this moment, the world in his eyes shattered.
The Demon Locking Well, the fox demon, the cave, the darkness, and even him, were all turned into billions of fragments.
Then, the fragments reassembled and the world lit up.
It's like the endless sky light pierces the eternal night.
He saw himself.
It was like standing on the clouds overlooking a city. He was standing at an unspeakable angle.
The skin, muscles, blood vessels, and bones fade away layer by layer, replaced by countless veins that exude a shimmering light.
Some spiral up to reach the heavenly spirit, and some zigzag down to cover the soles of the feet.
Intertwined with each other but not entangled, orderly and brilliant.
The movement of spiritual power, the route of the exercises, and even the remaining traces of the power of heaven and earth.
Things that were invisible in the past were now extremely clear in his consciousness.
As the assessment ended, the examiners in Suoyao Well no longer knew what to say.
"Two hundred and eighty-seven! That boy actually killed two hundred and eighty-seven fox demons!"
"On the second level of the Mortal Realm, he skipped the selection and went straight to the Demon Suppression Division. I thought he was just a make-up, but who would have thought that he would have such terrifying combat power!"
"Good boy, you are worthy of being a loyal queen. Even those first-class ones in previous years are not so incredible."
"It's different! In previous years, the Grade A students were graded as Grade A by the assessment. Lu Yuan's Grade A was because the highest grade in the assessment was only Grade A."
"You evildoer! I, Qingzhou Demon Suppressor, don't have any kind of genius, but who dares to call himself a genius in front of this kid?"
"It would take an average genius one year to go from entry level to demon-suppressing school lieutenant, but it only took him one day!"
"When he receives the Mortal Transformation Pill and enters the first realm, and then practices a set of Demon Suppressing Techniques, I can't even imagine how strong this kid will become."
"What is this kid? He is obviously Lord Lu, the captain of the Demon Suppressing School!"
"Hahahahaha..."
Outside the lock demon well.
The light on the stone tablet lit up.
There was only one person in Class A, Lu Yuan, and seven in Class B. He didn't pay attention to those in Class C and Mo.
Originally, Lin Chen was complacent because he got the second grade, but now when he saw the ranking on the stone tablet, he felt ashamed.
Today's shame, I'm afraid I won't be able to do anything about it in the future.
If the first defeat at the hands of Lu Yuan was a sneak attack, then today there is absolutely nothing to say.
A casual punch caused his muscles to break and his body to be seriously injured. This is such a terrifying cultivation level.
If it were a life and death battle, I'm afraid he would be cold by now.
Unprecedented helplessness welled up from the bottom of my heart.
The huge gap made him no longer dare to have any thoughts of revenge against Lu Yuan.
Amidst the exclamation, Lu Yuan walked out of the Suoyao Well, passed through the crowd, and stepped into the bell tower.
Not a single glance was cast from beginning to end.
Lin Chen secretly breathed a sigh of relief, but then strong shame and anger surged in his heart.
The people he regarded as his powerful rivals treated him as nothing, or even ignored him outright.
This was more difficult for him to accept than beating him seriously.
He spat out a mouthful of blood, rolled his eyes, and passed out.
Lu Yuan didn't pay attention to the small character in the corner.
He received a Metamorphosis Pill amidst the praise of the examiner.
The elixir pill is brown and looks like a chocolate. It is surrounded by elixir patterns on the surface and exudes bursts of medicinal fragrance.
Through these two days of contact with Lao Zhou, he was no stranger to this elixir.
Shedding the mortal elixir, GuAs the name suggests, it can help warriors shed their mortal bodies and enter the first realm, officially embarking on the path of cultivation.
The first state is the initial state.
Introduce the spirit into the body, let the spiritual power enter the meridians, open up the eight extraordinary meridians and the twelve main meridians, and form a circumferential circulation in the body, which is endless.
The second realm is the mysterious realm.
Guide the spiritual power to gather in the Dantian, open up the mysterious ruins, and continuously compress and solidify the spiritual power in it.
The third realm is the realm of transformation.
Xuanxu went up in the opposite direction and resonated with the soul, breaking through the bridge between heaven and earth, and accumulating spiritual consciousness.
When spiritual consciousness communicates with heaven and earth, and draws the power of heaven and earth to cast the foundation of the avenue, it will be possible to break through the realm of transformation and step into the realm of virtuality, but these are things for a later time.
Originally, Lu Yuan was worried that due to his limited qualifications, his cultivation progress would be several times slower than those of practitioners at the same level.
But now with the entry effect of [Comprehension Against Heaven], the previous worries have completely disappeared.
Practicing all the methods of heaven and earth is like observing patterns on the palm of your hand, which means that there are no bottlenecks or shackles. As long as the skills and resources are in place, your realm will rise with the tide.
He accepted the Shedding Pill, thanked the examiner who handed out the reward, and turned around to walk downstairs.
"Master Lu!"
As soon as he came down the stairs, a middle-aged man wearing a black brocade robe walked towards him.
The visitor had a smile on his face and was enthusiastic yet respectful.
"Congratulations, Mr. Lu, for killing 278 demons in the Demon Locking Well. He received an A-level evaluation and became the Demon Suppressing Captain at the beginning. He is really young and promising!"
Lu Yuan paused and looked at the other person up and down.
He is in his early thirties, wearing a dark brocade robe with dark patterns, a standard horizontal sword hanging on his waist, and the scabbard is shiny.
"Do I know you?"
The middle-aged man held up his hand and said, "I am Su Ding'an, who entered the army seven years earlier than you, and holds the post of demon-suppressing guard within the department."
Lu Yuan nodded, "Is something wrong?"
Su Ding'an came up and smiled, "If I'm not wrong, sir, are you going to Jingwu Pavilion?"
"Not bad."
Lu Yuan nodded, not surprised.
Newcomers who have passed the entrance examination will naturally go to Jingwu Pavilion to choose a technique after receiving the reward. Anyone who is interested can guess it with a little thought.
"Isn't this a coincidence? I happened to be on my way, let's go together."
As he spoke, he walked side by side with Lu Yuan, took out a book from his arms and handed it to Lu Yuan.
"Master Lu is new here, maybe you need this."
Lu Yuan lowered his head and saw a few neat large characters written in calligraphy on the cover of the book - "Qingzhou Demon Division Survival Guide".
There is also a line of small words next to it: Su Ding'an
"Survival guide?" Lu Yuan asked subconsciously.
"Not bad." Su Ding'an smiled and patted his chest, "This guide is the product of seven years of hard work."
"Talk about the Qingzhou Demon Suppression Department in detail. There are many ways to do it. Which canteen has delicious food, which latrine has a clean pit, which deacon has a bad temper and talks easily, and which places are not accessible, all are in this booklet."
As he spoke, he turned a page at random.
"Now, the list of subordinate officials."
"Old scribe Zhou hates flattery, so he talks less and nods more when meeting him; scribe old Li has a mysophobia, so he has to clean his clothes before going to him for business; scribe old Zhao's wife ran away with a gardener in the city, so try not to look for him these days."
Turn another page.
"Look, the guide to Jingwu Pavilion."
"The first level is for the general public, the second level is for advanced skills, and the third level is for core skills."
"Each floor is divided into zones. The east zone is for kung fu, and the west zone is for martial arts. The west zone is for martial arts, and the west zone is divided into fists and kicks, body skills, and weapons..."
Lu Yuan nodded, it seemed to be of some use.
Wherever there are people, there are people.
After receiving an A-level rating in the Suoyaojing assessment, he was considered a demon-suppressing captain upon entry. It was reasonable for him to show favor to his colleagues at this moment.
He took the book and bowed his hand towards Su Ding'an.
"Thank you, Brother Su!"
Just as he was about to leave, there was a sudden scream in his ear.
"Master Lu!"
Su Ding'an looked at him with a smile, and made a gesture with his index finger and thumb.
"SincerityHui, two taels of silver. "
